Alice needs to buy milk before going home.
Walking to the supermarket takes 20 minutes, and walking from the supermarket to home takes 15 minutes.
Can Alice buy milk before the supermarket closes?
To determine if Alice can buy milk before the supermarket closes, we need to calculate the total time it will take her to go to the supermarket and
- Walking to the supermarket takes 20 minutes.
- Walking from the supermarket to home takes 15 minutes.
Total time required: 20 minutes (to the supermarket) + 15 minutes (back home) = 35 minutes.
If Alice leaves now (7:30 PM), she will arrive back home at 7:30 PM + 35 minutes = 8:05 PM.
Since the supermarket closes at 8:00 PM, Alice will not be able to buy milk before it closes.
